title: HackerXBT
tagline: AI agent tracking hackathon commits live & launching winner tokens - alpha for judges/sponsors
description:
HackerXBT is an AI-powered agent that revolutionizes how hackathons are monitored, judged, and rewarded by providing real-time analytics and automated token launches for winning teams.Core Functionality:Our AI agent continuously monitors and analyzes hackathon participants' activities in real-time, creating a comprehensive intelligence layer for the entire hackathon ecosystem. It tracks GitHub commits, development patterns, tool usage, and team progress throughout the event, transforming raw data into actionable insights.Key Features:
Real-Time Commit Analysis

Monitors all participant GitHub repositories during the hackathon
Analyzes commit frequency, code quality, and development timeline
Identifies when teams are actively building vs. submitting pre-built solutions
Tracks which sponsored tools/APIs teams are implementing



Multi-Channel Intelligence Distribution

Twitter Integration: Posts live updates about notable commits, milestones, and team achievements
Telegram Integration: Sends real-time alerts to judges and sponsors about relevant projects
Creates a "build in public" atmosphere that increases hackathon transparency



Sponsor Matching System

Automatically identifies which teams are using specific sponsor tools/protocols
Alerts sponsors when teams implement their technology effectively
Helps sponsors discover high-potential projects they might otherwise miss
Provides competitive advantage by enabling early engagement with promising builders



Judge Dashboard

Comprehensive timeline view of each team's development process
Insights into technical challenges faced and solutions implemented
Verification that work was completed during hackathon timeframe
Context beyond final presentations for more informed judging



Automated Winner Token Launch

Upon hackathon completion, winning teams can opt to launch an ERC20 token
Creates immediate liquidity and recognition for successful projects
Enables community investment in promising builders
Establishes on-chain verification of hackathon achievements

Use Cases:
For Large Hackathons: In events where teams have their own tokens, HackerXBT provides alpha information about team performance, creating a prediction market dynamic around hackathon outcomes.

For Judges: Eliminates the "demo day only" evaluation problem by providing full context of the building journey, including pivots, problem-solving approaches, and actual time invested.

For Sponsors: Acts as an intelligent scout, identifying teams that not only use their tools but implement them effectively, enabling targeted prize allocation and potential investment opportunities.

For Participants: Rewards genuine builders with visibility and potential token-based funding, while creating accountability for the development process.
how_its_made:
We built HackerXBT by combining AI analysis with blockchain automation to create a real-time hackathon monitoring system.
Core Components:
1. Coinbase Agent Kit SDK

Powers our AI agent that analyzes GitHub commits and makes decisions
We use it to automatically identify which teams are using sponsor tools
Handles wallet operations for launching tokens for winners
The SDK's LLM integration helps understand commit messages and code patterns

2. GitHub Monitoring

Set up webhooks to track all participant repositories
Every commit, PR, and issue triggers our analysis pipeline
We built a simple scoring system based on commit frequency and size
The agent learns to spot teams that are genuinely building vs. submitting old code

3. Flow Blockchain

Handles the token launch functionality for winning teams
We chose Flow for its lower gas costs and developer-friendly approach
Built smart contracts that create ERC20 tokens with one function call
Winners can claim and customize their token after the hackathon
